name: ahto
description: AHTO: test-matrix-driven integration testing across hardware, software, and services.

scripts.check:setup-assistant: node ./core/setup_assistant.mjs inspect --profile ./examples/iot-dashboard/profile.json --json > .ahto-setup-inspect.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.ahto-setup-inspect.json','utf8')); if(!Array.isArray(data.inputs)||!data.inputs.length) throw new Error('missing setup inputs'); if(!data.missingRequired.includes('AHTO_CDP_HOST')) throw new Error('expected missing AHTO_CDP_HOST'); console.log('setup-assistant-ok')" && rm -f .ahto-setup-inspect.json
scripts.check:review-runner: rm -rf .ahto-review-run && AHTO_SYNC_OK=1 node ./core/review_runner.mjs run --profile ./examples/iot-dashboard/profile.json --matrix ./examples/iot-dashboard/matrices/checkpoints/smoke-checkpoint-v2026-04-24.json --fixture ./examples/iot-dashboard/fixture-results/checkpoint-review.json --outDir ./.ahto-review-run > .ahto-review-run.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const result=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.ahto-review-run.json','utf8')); if(result.counts.rowsProductDefect!==1) throw new Error('expected one product defect'); if(result.counts.rowsRigBlocked!==1) throw new Error('expected one rig-blocked row'); if(result.counts.rowsPassed!==1) throw new Error('expected one passed row'); console.log('review-runner-ok')" && rm -rf .ahto-review-run .ahto-review-run.json
scripts.check:surface: npm pack --dry-run --json > .ahto-pack-dry-run.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.ahto-pack-dry-run.json','utf8')); const files=(data[0]&&data[0].files||[]).map(f=>f.path); const must=['SKILL.md','README.md','LICENSE','docs/architecture.md','docs/matrix-lifecycle.md','docs/modes-and-classification.md','docs/setup-profile.md','docs/review-runner.md','docs/packaged-workflow.md','core/contracts.mjs','core/review_runner.mjs','core/setup_assistant.mjs','core/emit_defect_record.mjs','core/emit_run_summary.mjs','adapters/notion/README.md','adapters/cdp/README.md','adapters/hardware-sync/README.md','examples/iot-dashboard/README.md','examples/iot-dashboard/profile.json','examples/iot-dashboard/test-matrix.json','examples/iot-dashboard/matrices/checkpoints/smoke-checkpoint-v2026-04-24.json','examples/iot-dashboard/fixture-results/checkpoint-review.json']; const forbidden=['references/','scripts/','output/']; must.forEach(p=>{ if(!files.includes(p)) throw new Error('missing packaged path: '+p); }); forbidden.forEach(prefix=>{ if(files.some(f=>f===prefix || f.startsWith(prefix))) throw new Error('forbidden packaged path: '+prefix); }); console.log('surface-ok')" && rm -f .ahto-pack-dry-run.json
scripts.check: npm run check:notion-adapter && npm run check:cdp-adapter && npm run check:core && npm run check:example-json && npm run check:setup-assistant && npm run check:review-runner && npm run check:surface
scripts.check:private-residue: echo 'Run a fresh residue audit before any future release decision.'
